fr_html: M. LODER n'est pas satisfait du mot „instruction" dans le texte du projet. Ce mot lui semble trop étroit.
en_html: M. LODER was not satisfied with the word "instruction" in the French text of the plan. It seemed to him that the meaning was too narrow.
